meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 当你需要查找科学论文时，Claude能搜索论文并返回结构化的实验数据，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分等，每篇论文提供25个以上的字段。
howto.when: 当你请求搜索科学论文，特别是需要完整的实验细节、定量结果或方法学比较时，会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文。
say.note: Claude会调用BGPT搜索并返回结构化结果。

say.text: 找几篇比较不同研究样本量的文献。
say.note: Claude会返回包含样本量字段的论文数据。

howto.what_en: When you need to search for scientific papers, Claude can search and return structured experimental data including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and over 25 fields per paper.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you ask to search for scientific papers, especially when you need full experimental details, quantitative results, or methodology comparisons.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Claude will call BGPT and return structured results.

say_en.text: Find papers comparing sample sizes across different studies.
say_en.note: Claude will return papers with sample size field.
